mapper.select: /*commonPopupMpso.poDetailPopHd*/ SELECT DISTINCT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , DECODE(H.DOC_TYPE,'S','(선입고)','F','(긴급발주)','') DOC_TEXT , (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS PO_DEPT_NAME, (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.REQ_DEPT) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME , H.PO_NO AS PO_NO , H.PURCHASER_NAME AS PO_USER_NAME , (SELECT L.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR L WHERE L.COM_CODE = H.BUYER AND L.USER_ID = R.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME , H.PO_CREATE_DATE , H.AGENT_PO_TTL_AMT AS AGENT_AMT , H.PO_TTL_AMT AS PO_AMT , H.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY , H.PO_REMARK AS REMARK , H.DOC_TYPE , H.BUYER , R.PURCHASER_DEPT , R.REQ_DEPT , H.PURCHASER_ID , R.REQ_USER_ID , DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'0','직납','1','재고','2','T/R','3','VMI') AS PROCESS_TYPE , H.ADD_USER_ID , H.SELLER , R.ADD_USER_TEL FROM ICOMPOHD H, ICOMPODT D, ICOMPRDT R WHERE H.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND H.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND H.BUYER = D.BUYER AND H.PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND D.BUYER = R.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = R.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ = R.PR_SEQ AND ROWNUM = 1

/*commonPopupMpso.poDetailPopDt*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME , D.BUYER_ITEM_NO , H.PO_CREATE_DATE , NVL(D.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE , NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY , TRUNC(NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) * NVL(D.UNIT_PRICE,0)) AS PO_AMT , D.MAKER_NAME , D.LEGACY_PO_NO , D.PO_SEQ , D.REF_PR_NO , D.RD_DATE , NVL(D.AGENT_PRICE,0) AS AGENT_PRICE , D.UNIT_MEASURE , TRUNC(NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) * NVL(D.AGENT_PRICE,0)) AS AGENT_AMT , D.SELLER_ITEM_NO , D.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , D.DESCRIPTION , D.SPECIFICATION , D.PO_REMARK , D.PO_NO , D.BUYER , H.AGENT , D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , D.CONTRACT_NO , D.CONTRACT_SEQ , D.STATUS FROM ICOMPODT D, ICOMPOHD H WHERE D.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND D.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND D.BUYER = H.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = H.PO_NO ORDER BY D.PO_SEQ

/*commonPopupMpso.poDetailHistPopHd*/ SELECT DISTINCT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , DECODE(H.DOC_TYPE,'S','(선입고)','F','(긴급발주)','') DOC_TEXT , (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS PO_DEPT_NAME, (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.REQ_DEPT) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME , H.PO_NO AS PO_NO , H.PURCHASER_NAME AS PO_USER_NAME , (SELECT L.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR L WHERE L.COM_CODE = H.BUYER AND L.USER_ID = R.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME , H.PO_CREATE_DATE , H.AGENT_PO_TTL_AMT AS AGENT_AMT , H.PO_TTL_AMT AS PO_AMT , H2.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY , H.PO_REMARK AS REMARK , H.DOC_TYPE , H.BUYER , R.PURCHASER_DEPT , R.REQ_DEPT , H2.PURCHASER_ID , R.REQ_USER_ID , DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'0','직납','1','재고','2','T/R','3','VMI') AS PROCESS_TYPE , H.ADD_USER_ID , H2.SELLER , R.ADD_USER_TEL FROM ICOMPOHD_HIST H , ICOMPODT_HIST D , ICOMPRDT R , ICOMPOHD H2 WHERE H.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND H.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND H.BUYER = D.BUYER AND H.PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND D.BUYER = R.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = R.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ = R.PR_SEQ AND H.BUYER = H2.BUYER AND H.PO_NO = H2.PO_NO AND ROWNUM = 1

/*commonPopupMpso.poDetailHistPopDt*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME , D.BUYER_ITEM_NO , H.PO_CREATE_DATE , NVL(D.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE , NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY , TRUNC(NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) * NVL(D.UNIT_PRICE,0)) AS PO_AMT , D.MAKER_NAME , D.LEGACY_PO_NO , D.PO_SEQ , D.REF_PR_NO , D.RD_DATE , NVL(D.AGENT_PRICE,0) AS AGENT_PRICE , D.UNIT_MEASURE , TRUNC(NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) * NVL(D.AGENT_PRICE,0)) AS AGENT_AMT , D.SELLER_ITEM_NO , D.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , D.DESCRIPTION , D.SPECIFICATION , D.PO_REMARK , D.PO_NO , D.BUYER , H.AGENT , D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , D.CONTRACT_NO , D.CONTRACT_SEQ FROM ICOMPODT_HIST D, ICOMPOHD_HIST H WHERE D.BUYER = H.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = H.PO_NO AND H.HIST_ID = D.HIST_ID AND D.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND D.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND H.HIST_ID = #{st_hist_id} AND TO_CHAR(H.HIST_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDD') LIKE SUBSTR( #{st_hist_dttm},1,6 ) || '%' ORDER BY H.HIST_DTTM DESC
